dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge is characterized by a short vertical drop from the apex followed by a straight linear slope to the posterior base, exhibiting negligible concave curvature or falcation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is acute and sharply pointed with a minimal pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin follows a straight diagonal path at an angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal base axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 1.8:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small white punctate marks are visible on the lateral surface of the fin, possibly representing minor lesions or pigmentation markers.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly triangular fin morphology with a distinct linear trailing edge profile, lacking the typical falcate curvature seen in many delphinids.
